Name: Doctor Wilson Outfits
Author: scoorpsie
Description:
All of Harvey’s in-game sprites (default, summer, winter, beach, and hospital work attire, along with festival outfits) are replaced with outfits inspired by Dr. Wilson.  
Matching character portraits replacing Harvey’s to the clean-shaven, greying and cute boywonder oncologist.
All outfits reference James Wilson's different outfits thoughout the show: his sweater vests, green tie, his McGill Sweatshirt and even his Moose Headband.

For the ones who would like to also change Harvey's name to Wilson's, I use Ultimate Villager Manager mod! https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271

Credits of the original outfits to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister/mods]Poltergeister[/url] and the SCA mod I used in order to do the character variations! See credits tab for full credits of all the artist who participated

Note!! This is my first time ever using Nexus and making a mod, posting whatsoever. If im doing any mistake, something doesn't work, you find an asset that was from other artist I missed from Poltergeister's credits, please dm me and let me know! I'm trying my best and, as an artist too, I don't want to make any artist that are so valuable for our community uncomfortable with my mistakes. Please be patient with me! Also, thanks for everyone who's reaching out and helping me manage this mod!
